title: Предварительный обзор — 12 ноября 2026 г.
intro:
Crude oil benchmarks are pushing higher this morning with WTI at 87.30 up 0.89 percent and Brent at 93.97 up 1.30 percent. The advance is being driven by mounting supply and Middle East geopolitical tensions, notably underscored by comments that a deal with Iran is unnecessary.
Market theme
Risk appetite is decidedly sour today as a surging VIX up 8.46 percent to 18.97 and rising US Treasury yields led by the 10-year up 5.0 basis points to 5.048 percent weigh heavily on risk assets. Meanwhile, precious metals and cryptocurrencies are experiencing broad liquidations alongside tech equities.
Potential scenario
Potential scenario: For the US cash open, the base case anticipates continued downside pressure testing the S&P 500 futures at 7,584.75 as tech weakness persists. The alternative scenario involves a defensive rotation into energy shares like Exxon up 3.09 percent, which could help stabilize the Dow futures near 52,387.
Key risks
• Intensifying semiconductor sector sell-off and regulatory headlines surrounding Nvidia
• Spiking Treasury yields and surging volatility threatening broader equity multiples
